rationale: AEHL has gapped up 183% from prior close with no news catalyst identified, creating extreme uncertainty about the driver and sustainability of the move. The single 1-minute candle shows a wide range (22.01–24.48) with price already fading from the open high, sitting at only 30% of today's range with the last print below VWAP and well below the 9-EMA — suggesting distribution rather than continuation. The 158 bps bid-ask spread and thin float make precise stop placement and execution highly unreliable, with slippage risk on either side making risk/reward unquantifiable.
